answer: In this PoA model, each validator’s reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so only sustained, verifiable honest service preserves influence. A freshly spawned Sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming endorsements; reciprocal collusion cannot bootstrap it under reciprocity-weighted transitivity. It therefore remains at the nadir, unable to pass consensus, while stale reputation is a relic rather than a harbor for instant authority.
